text: {"standards":[{"code":"RL.6.9","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Part B1 and Part B2, students read the Homeric excerpt, fill a Homer/Both/Riordan Venn diagram, and write a paragraph comparing how the two versions handle jealousy and betrayal and how their voice and tone differ."},{"code":"L.6.4","verdict":"taught","reason":"In the Vocabulary in Context activity, students use sentence clues and word parts to work out multiple-meaning words such as crippled, clouded, and temperamental, checking which meaning fits the sentence."},{"code":"L.6.5.a","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Part A, students mark similes, hyperbole, and other figurative language in Chapter 15 and explain how Ares's exaggerated speech shapes the tone, with a Pulse Check on the effect."},{"code":"L.6.6","verdict":"taught","reason":"Students add the Chapter 15 academic and domain words to their organizers and must use at least two of today's vocabulary words in the comparison paragraph and exit ticket."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The Lesson has students read Chapter 15 pp. 224–233 in Part A and the vocabulary work, and pairs them with the adapted Homeric excerpt, which matches the texts and pages the Outline names."}}
